'''Davit Lokyan'''  ([[Armenian language|Armenian]]: Դավիթ Լոքյան; born: January 20, 1958<ref>{{cite web |title=LOKYAN David - National Assembly of Armenia |url=http://www.parliament.am/deputies.php?sel=details&ID=312&lang=eng |website=parliament.am |accessdate=14 August 2020}}</ref>) is an Armenian politician.<ref>{{cite news |title=Davit Lokyan briefs President Sargsyan on priorities of the Ministry |url=https://armenpress.am/eng/news/880036 |publisher=[[Armenpress]] |date=February 23, 2017}}</ref> He served as the Minister of Territorial Administration and Development of [[Armenia]] from 2016 to 2018. 

== Biography ==
He was born on January 20, 1958, in [[Ninotsminda]], [[Soviet Georgia]]. 

; Positions held
* 1998-1999 - Deputy Governor of [[Lori Region]].
* May 30, 1999 - Elected [[Member of Parliament]]. Member of the Standing Committee on Fiscal, Credit and Economic Affairs. Head of the ARF faction.
* 2001-2003 - was the Minister of Urban Development of Armenia.
* 2003-2008 - Minister of Agriculture of Armenia.
* On February 24, 2016, by the decree of the [[President of Armenia]], he was appointed Minister of Territorial Administration and Development of [[Armenia]].
* On April 19, 2018, Lokyan became the Minister of Territorial Administration and Development of Armenia in the [[Second Serzh Sargsyan government|government of Serzh Sargsyan]].<ref>[http://newsarmenia.am/news/politics/biografiya-ministra-territorialnogo-upravleniya-i-razvitiya-armenii/ Биография министра территориального управления и развития Армении]</ref> On April 23, as a result of protests, Sargsyan left office and [[Karen Karapetyan]] became prime minister, while Lokyan remained in his post as acting.<ref>[http://newsarmenia.am/news/armenia/prezident-armenii-zavershil-formirovanie-pravitelstva-strany/ Президент Армении завершил формирование правительства страны]</ref> Three days later David Lokyan submitted his resignation.{{cn|date=December 2020}}
